Coverage: HR. The portal shows the English title as "Management Areas - Areas with Potentially Significant Flood Risks 2018 - WMS - INSPIRE" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include poplava, rizik, Hrvatske vode, inspiregeoportal. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nipp.
